edge_cases: first block: running_max initialized very negative but finite (-30000.0), running_sum=0, acc=0 (corr ~= 0, old state contributes ~nothing)
second block with a REAL rescale: prior nonzero running_max/running_sum/acc, block max forced above the prior running_max (m_new>m_old, corr<1)
second block with corr==1 but nonzero prior state (m_new==m_old, distinguishes from the all-zero first-block case)
BLK=24 and D=48, neither a multiple of 64 fp16 lanes -- real tail/padding on both axes
exp is UNAVOIDABLY scalar (no HVX vector transcendental); only the accumulate/rescale is vectorized
fp16 tolerance compare (HVX qf16 arithmetic is non-IEEE), covers running_max, running_sum, and every acc[] element
classic dropped-rescale near-miss must fail whenever corr<1 is exercised
name: online_softmax_step_fp16
